meta.name: meta-ads-audit
meta.description: Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other Meta ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my Meta ads", "audit my Facebook ads", "Meta ads audit", "set up my Meta ads", "onboard Meta", "Meta account overview", "how's my Meta account", "Meta health check", "what should I fix in my Facebook ads", or when the user is new to NotFair Meta and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other Meta ads skills detect that meta business-context.json is missing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以只读方式审计你的 Meta 广告账户：收集账户、广告系列、广告组与 Pixel 数据，从 7 个维度打分，输出含前 3 项行动的报告，并保存业务信息与用户画像文件供其他技能复用。修复通过 /meta-ads 执行。
howto.when: 当你说“审计我的 Meta 广告”“审计我的 Facebook 广告”等指令时触发；新用户首次使用、或另一技能发现业务上下文文件缺失时也会主动触发。
